description: Activate when: user asks 'where does our competitive advantage come from', 'why are our margins lower than competitors', 'which activities create value', 'how is the competitor doing it cheaper', 'cost structure analysis', 'make vs. buy decision', 'which activities should we outsource', or is evaluating an acquisition for synergies or designing competitive strategy. Do NOT activate when: the business is a platform/multisided market (use network effects analysis instead); the question is industry-level rather than firm-level (use Porter's Five Forces instead). More: deciqai.com/c/value-chain-analysis
